data.name_rationale: Vantyx is coined from 'vantage point' — the single thing a view-led buyer is paying for. The '-yx' ending makes it ownable, platform-scalable, and premium-tech without being literal. It promises the best seat in the building, on demand.

mission.statement: Vantyx exists to help developers sell the view — by turning every floor's real, ever-changing outlook into an immersive experience buyers can step into, and keep true as the building rises.

breakdown.action: turn the view into an immersive, self-updating experience
breakdown.outcome: buyers can step into the real view from any floor, anytime
breakdown.differentiator: kept true to today, non-destructively, by the builder themselves

vision.statement: A world where no one buys a home sight-unseen — where the view from any floor, at any hour, is one tap away and always true to today.

values.name: The view is the product
values.definition: Buyers pay for what they will see; everything we build serves the fidelity of that view.
values.in_practice: We optimize capture, resolution and load so the 360 feels like standing on the slab — never a gimmick reel.

values.name: Never go dark
values.definition: A live sales tool must not break, ever — especially mid-update.
values.in_practice: Updates are non-destructive and atomic: the running tour stays up until the new version is validated, then flips instantly (and rolls back instantly).

values.name: Builders, not engineers
values.definition: The people keeping views current are marketing teams, not developers.
values.in_practice: If updating a floor needs a manual or a deploy, we failed. Upload, preview, publish — done.

values.name: Always true to today
values.definition: A two-year-old view is a lie; current is the whole point.
values.in_practice: We make re-capturing and re-publishing a floor effortless, so what buyers see is what's real now.

personality.archetype_rationale: Magician: we teleport a buyer onto a floor that may not be built yet and let them feel the view. Sage tempers it with truth and reliability — always-current, never-breaks.

if_a_person.communication_style: confident, precise, quietly impressive — lets the view do the talking
